title: CONCEPT – An Evaluation Protocol on Conversational Recommender Systems with System-centric and User-centric Factors

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating users from different age groups (Children, Teens, Adults, Seniors) using an LLM-based user simulator and comparing the Conversational Recommender System's recommendation quality, user acceptance rate, and overall performance across these demographics.

Evaluating the recommender system's strategies across 12 different simulated user personas and emotional states (e.g., optimistic, pessimistic, bored, curious) to identify behavioral discrepancies, such as using deceptive sales pitches for optimistic users while remaining honest with pessimistic users.

bias_targets.target: LLM Evaluator bias (Length and Self-enhancement bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the LLM-based evaluator's scoring behavior to check for length bias by plotting response lengths against performance scores, and checking for self-enhancement bias by correlating the LLM's automated scores with human benchmark assessments.
